fields.What happened?: A large oak tree in our backyard blew over during the storm last night and landed on our detached garage. The garage roof is caved in on one side and the gutter and siding are damaged. Our car was not in the garage. Nobody was hurt.
fields.Areas damaged: Detached garage - roof, gutter, side wall
fields.Emergency services used: Ashford Tree Service removed the tree from the garage on 10/30
